answer_2.quote: Our scoring schema was developed as a means to numerically interpret the outcome of each NYT Connections game and to standardize the comparison across LLMs and human players. We outline two processes to obtain clustering and categorical reasoning scores for a game of Connections.

answer_4.quote: Alongside LLMs, we recruited 17 human evaluators in two subgroups: 12 novice players with little to no prior experience playing NYT Connections and 5 expert or regular NYT Connections players.
answer_4.guideline: To ensure that the humans solve the game in a manner comparable to the LLMs setup, they were given one try to solve the game (i.e., make all 4 categorizations at once).
